plain: Being forced to act by pressure, or an urge that is hard to resist.

webster.text: The act of driving or urging by force, physical or moral; force applied; constraint of the will; the application of a force that is irresistible.

example.quote: The more it circulates through those channels and currents in which the passions of mankind naturally flow, the less will it require the aid of the violent and perilous expedients of compulsion.
